condition: On a 1-row DataFrame, df.loc[:, col] = <length-1 NumPy array or Series> into a PyArrow-backed column raises TypeError "Invalid value ... for dtype 'double[pyarrow]'" because the length-1 array is unwrapped to a 0-d ndarray that pa.scalar can't convert.
workaround: Assign a value that keeps the Arrow dtype (e.g. df["A"] = ... or cast the RHS to the column's Arrow dtype with .astype(df["A"].dtype)), or don't use loc[:, col] for this assignment.
